Signed-off-by: Tony Lin <tony.lin@intel.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm.config.parallel.ParallelConfig.nnodes_within_dp (vllm/config/parallel.py:762) — now raises ValueError when nnodes is not divisible by data_parallel_size // data_parallel_size_local (internal LB), and clamps to max(...,1) under data_parallel_external_lb

vllm_ascend.patch.platform.patch_multiproc_executor.AscendMultiprocExecutor._get_parallel_sizes (assert self.world_size % parallel_config.nnodes_within_dp == 0) — previously ZeroDivisionError when nnodes_within_dp rounded down to 0
vllm_ascend.platform.NPUPlatform.check_and_update_config DyntraLB branch (parallel_config.nnodes_within_dp > 1 check, platform.py:1005)
vllm_ascend.worker.worker.NPUWorker._init_device device-binding gate (parallel_config.nnodes_within_dp == 1, worker.py:388) and memory check (worker.py:465)
vllm_ascend._310p.worker_310p device-binding gate (nnodes_within_dp == 1, worker_310p.py:177)

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: No signature change: vllm-ascend consumes nnodes_within_dp/node_rank_within_dp/local_world_size dynamically, so the fix is inherited. Work needed is verification plus regression coverage rather than a core rewrite: (1) vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_multiproc_executor.py::AscendMultiprocExecutor._get_parallel_sizes — confirm the world_size % nnodes_within_dp assert no longer hits the old floor-to-zero path for external-LB DP; assert the new ValueError is acceptable for internal-LB uneven-nnodes configs. (2) vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py::NPUWorker._init_device (line ~388) and vllm_ascend/_310p/worker_310p.py (line ~177) — the `nnodes_within_dp == 1` gate now becomes true for external-LB deployments with more replicas than nodes, which re-enables the `local_rank += dp_local_rank * tp_pp_world_size` shift; verify NPU device binding with --nnodes > 1 + --data-parallel-rank, ensuring local_rank stays within ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES/assigned_physical_gpu_ids. (3) vllm_ascend/platform.py DyntraLB check (line ~1005) — re-validate single-node decoder assumption under the clamped value. (4) vllm_ascend/compilation/compiler_interface.py:99 — LOCAL_WORLD_SIZE depends on local_world_size; re-check for external-LB multi-node. (5) Add a UT mirroring upstream tests/test_config.py::test_nnodes_within_dp_when_replicas_outnumber_nodes and tests/v1/engine/test_engine_args.py external-LB cases, ideally in tests/ut/test_platform.py or a ParallelConfig test, constructing ParallelConfig with data_parallel_external_lb=True/data_parallel_size_local=1 and asserting nnodes_within_dp >= 1 and that explicit data_parallel_rank is preserved. (6) The Ascend external-DP launcher (examples/external_online_dp/launch_online_dp.py + run_dp_template.sh) already passes an explicit --data-parallel-rank and no --nnodes, so it is unaffected; update docs only if multi-node external-LB with --nnodes is documented. (7) vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_parallel_config.py: the v0.29.0 lane keeps the old nnodes_within_dp, so the release lane still exhibits the floor-to-zero bug — decide whether to backport the clamp into the patch or require vllm >= fixed main.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. Upstream-only bugfix with no API/signature change; the main risk is a silent behavioral shift in NPU device binding for multi-node external-LB DP where replicas share nodes: the new clamp makes `nnodes_within_dp == 1` true where it was previously 0, re-enabling the dp_local_rank local_rank shift and potentially tripping the local_rank/device-count asserts in NPUWorker._init_device. Secondary risk: the new ValueError in nnodes_within_dp can now surface at runtime for internal-LB configs whose nnodes is not divisible by the DP node group size (previously silently mis-computed), including anywhere vllm-ascend dereferences local_world_size/node_rank_within_dp; and on the v0.29.0 release lane the patch_parallel_config copy means the fix is absent, so lanes can diverge unless the clamp is backported. No compile-time or interface breakage expected.

commits.comment: 修复 pooling/embedding 接口在长文本分块（chunked）聚合时的归一化不一致问题。_ChunkedPromptAggregator 新增 num_chunks 与 all_chunks_l2_normalized 计数，在 use_activation 为真时对每个 chunk 的 embedding 用 torch.linalg.vector_norm + torch.allclose（rtol=1e-2, atol=1e-5）判断其是否已是 L2 归一化，累积结果；最终在 num_chunks > 1 且所有 chunk 都已归一化时，对加权平均后的 final_embedding 再做一次 torch.nn.functional.normalize（dim=-1）。这样既修复了分块与整段归一化结果的偏差，又通过 all_chunks_l2_normalized 的启发式判断避免对自定义激活（本就不保证 L2 归一化）施加额外归一化，代价是引入了基于容差的启发式，若某个模型激活输出恰好接近单位范数但并非真正的 L2 归一化，行为可能与该模型预期略有差异。
